title: Learning Shortest Paths with Generative Flow Networks
abstract: arXiv:2603.01786v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this paper, we present a novel learning framework for finding shortest paths in graphs utilizing Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets). First, we examine theoretical properties of GFlowNets in non-acyclic environments in relation to shortest paths. We prove that, if the total flow is minimized, forward and backward policies traverse the environment graph exclusively along shortest paths between the initial and terminal states. Building on this result, we reduce shortest-path finding in an arbitrary unweighted graph to finding a non-acyclic GFlowNet with minimal total flow, and approximate it in practice by training with flow regularization. We experimentally demonstrate the performance of our method in pathfinding in permutation environments and in solving Rubik's Cubes of various sizes. translated_title: 基于生成流网络的最短路径学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.01786v2 公告类型： replace-cross 摘要：在本文中，我们提出了一种利用生成流网络（GFlowNets）在图中寻找最短路径的新型学习框架。首先，我们研究了GFlowNets在含环（非无环）环境中与最短路径相关的理论性质。我们证明，当总流量被最小化时，前向和后向策略将仅在初始状态与终止状态之间的最短路径上遍历环境图。基于这一结果，我们将任意无权图中的最短路径寻找问题转化为寻找具有最小总流量的非无环GFlowNet问题，并在实践中通过带流正则化的训练对其进行近似求解。我们通过实验展示了该方法在置换环境寻路任务以及求解不同规模魔方问题上的性能。对于魔方求解问题，我们的方法与专门为此设计的最先进机器学习方法相比取得了具有竞争力的结果。
tldr: 该论文提出了基于生成流网络（GFlowNets）的最短路径学习新框架，证明了最小化总流量的GFlowNet策略必沿最短路径遍历，从而将最短路径寻找问题转化为最小总流量问题，并在置换环境寻路和魔方求解任务中取得了与专用最先进方法相当的效果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel framework for finding shortest paths in graphs using GFlowNets, proving that minimizing the total flow makes forward and backward policies traverse exclusively along shortest paths, thereby reducing shortest-path finding to a flow-minimization problem, and achieving competitive results on permutation pathfinding and Rubik's Cube solving compared to state-of-the-art specialized machine learning approaches.
